race.comment: FLYING BAT (2) began awkwardly and had to do a bit of work to find the lead so it was no surprise to see him capitulate last start over this distance at Doomben. Form prior to that was difficult to fault. In the right race to bounce back to winning ways. LUCONI (5) returned from a six-month spell with an eye-catcher last time out, coming from midfield to be beaten a neck over 1400m at the Gold Coast. Big drop in grade today and the extra trip at the second run back looks ideal. Serious threat. The stayer TEWKESBURY (3) is back after a four-month break. Placed at two of four runs when fresh. Not a prolific winner but he could bob up in a race like this while a bit on the new side. DIVIL A BIT (9) led but found a couple better near the line last start over 1800m at the Gold Coast. Will roll along and give them something to catch. CLASSIQUE GAL (10) is a chance if she finds the form from two back when a massive winner over 1710m at this track.
